interventions.detail: INSTALL.md conda example pins pytorch 1.13/CUDA 11.6/py3.9, inconsistent with listed supported PyTorch 2.1-2.4.1
Installed torch==2.4.1, torchvision==0.19.1 CPU wheels and numpy<2 in a Python 3.12 uv venv
Needed --no-build-isolation (setup.py imports torch) plus setuptools/wheel/ninja preinstalled
apt install python3-dev; build failed with missing Python.h
FORCE_CUDA=0 and CPU-only torch to build the CPU-only extension on a GPU-less machine
